{{Quote|My Master. The great Mak Luunim. He commissioned work from Muunilinst's finest artisans, and naturally, they were all inspired to turn their talents to his noble form.|Mak Luunim's employee on Mak Luunim|<ref name="Target" />}}
A [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] worked as an '''employee''' of [[Mak Luunim]], a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and an avid [[Collector/Legends|collector]] of art, in his [[Mak Luunim's apartment|home]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Pilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], shortly after Luunim's [[Death/Legends|death]], fellow Rebels [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], accompanied by their [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and undercover [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7|Tobin Elad]], visited his apartment during a [[Mission to Muunilinst|mission]] for the Alliance. The employee led them into the apartment, where they were ambushed by six [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] under the employment of [[Nal Kenuun]], a feared [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] who instigated Luunim's death. A brief shootout ensued, during which Solo saved the employee's life by shoving him out of the path of incoming blasterfire.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I have no master''"<br />"''But you said Luunim was your master.''"<br />"''Indeed. ''Was'' my master. Is no more. The noble Mak Luunim has left us.|Mak Luunim's employee and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Target" />}}
A [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] served [[Mak Luunim]], a dedicated art [[Collector/Legends|collector]] and a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], at his [[Mak Luunim's apartment|home]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Pilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict fought between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Target" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'' to [[0 ABY]].</ref> Luunim was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] accident. Shortly thereafter, a group consisting of Alliance members [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], their [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[X-7|Tobin Elad]]&mdash;secretly an Imperial [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] working undercover&mdash;visited Luunim's apartment in search of him. Their [[Mission to Muunilinst|mission]] was to recover a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] [[Accountant/Legends|handled]] by Luunim that contained access codes to several financial accounts that the Alliance desperately needed.<ref name="Target" />

[[File:LeiaOrgana-TSS.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Princess Leia Organa (pictured) was led into a trap by the employee]]
Luunim's employee met them in the apartment's entry area and offered a brief explanation for the numerous [[Marble/Legends|marble]] sculptures bearing the likeness of his master. He led the group through a hidden entryway concealed within a marble wall and into a lavish parlor crowded with gilded paintings, [[Gold/Legends|golden]] statuettes, and furniture containing more gold than fabric. Inside the room, their path to the only exit was blocked by the sudden arrival of six [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Nal Kenuun]], a terrifying [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] who had orchestrated Luunim's death.<ref name="Target" /> 

Realizing that Luunim's employee had lured them into an ambush, the Rebels exchanged blasterfire with the stormtroopers rather than be brought in for questioning. Caught in the middle of the fight, the employee did his best to save Luunim's collection from being destroyed in the carnage. Although he had betrayed them, Solo nevertheless shoved the employee out of the path of incoming blasterfire, saving his life because he believed the Muun did not deserve to die for his actions.<ref name="Target" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The master wouldn't like this at all!|Mak Luunim's employee|<ref name="Target" />}}
Demonstrating great loyalty to his master's memory, Mak Luunim's sallow-faced employee risked his life during the blaster fight between the Rebels and the stormtroopers to save the art collection from destruction. He darted around the secret room to brace tottering golden vases and throw himself over priceless heirlooms to shield them from harm, showing little regard for his own safety. The employee also displayed a sly and deceptive nature, tricking the visiting Rebels into the secret room of his master's apartment, where they were trapped by a squad of stormtroopers.<ref name="Target" />

==Equipment==
The individual wore a simple [[Robe/Legends|robe]] of [[Color/Legends|gray]] and brown.<ref name="Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mak Luunim's employee appeared in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2008]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'', the first volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series.<ref name="Target" />
